items: Tajurbe (experiment) ke temperature par munasib solvent mein madde ka saturated solution (jis mein aur madda hal na ho sake) banayen.

Phir garam saturated solution ko filter kar ke insoluble impurities (jo hal nahi hoti) nikal dein. Garam filter karne se solute waqt se pehle (premature) filter paper ya funnel ki nali (stem) mein crystals nahi banata. Zaroorat ho to is ke liye hot water funnel istemal karein.
Garam filter kiye solution ko darmiyani raftar (moderate rate) se thanda karein taake darmiyane size ke crystals banein.
Jab crystallization mukammal ho jaye to crystals aur mother liquor (bacha hua solution) ke mixture ko vacuum pump ke saath Gooch crucible se filter karein.
Crystals hawa mein ya oven mein sukhaye ja sakte hain. Oven mein sirf tab sukhayen jab madda 100° C par garam hone se na pighle aur na toote (decompose ho).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Kabhi kabhi kachcha (crude) madda banate waqt rang dene wali cheezen ya resin jaise madde product ki shakal kharab kar dete hain. Inhen hatane ke liye madde ko solvent mein kafi miqdar ke bareek pise animal charcoal ke saath ubala jata hai, phir garam solution filter kiya jata hai. Rangeen impurities charcoal ki satah par chipak (adsorb ho) jati hain, aur thanda hone par filtrate se khalis, be-rang madda crystals ban kar nikalta hai.

blocks.alt: Baayen se daayen paanch marahil: beaker mein ek solid aur na-halne wali na-paki ka solution; funnel aur filter paper se evaporating dish mein filter karna; tripod par burner se garam kar ke hajm kam karna; garam liquid ko chapti dish mein dalna; thanda hone par crystals banna.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Crystallization ke mukhtalif marahil (kitab ki Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tasveer baayen se daayen parhein: (1) beaker mein ek solid ka solution aur na hal hone wali impurity; (2) filter kar ke zaid solid alag; (3) evaporating dish mein garam kar ke solution ka volume kam karna; (4) garam liquid dish mein dalna; (5) thanda chhorne par saturated solution se crystals banna.

Crystals sukhane ka mehfooz aur bharose ka tareeqa vacuum desiccator hai. Is mein crystals ko watch glass par phaila kar kai ghante vacuum desiccator mein rakha jata hai. Desiccator mein drying agents (nami choosne wale madde) CaCl₂, silica gel ya phosphorus pentoxide hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Figure 15.9' likhti hai, lekin Figure 15.9 paper chromatography (ascending aur descending) ki tasveer hai. Kitab mein vacuum desiccator ki koi tasveer nahi.

blocks.prompt: a) Crystallization ka bunyadi usool kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Solute munasib solvent mein zyada temperature par hal ho jata hai; solution thanda karne par zaid solute crystals ki shakal mein nikal aata hai aur impurities solution mein reh jati hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Crystallization ke liye munasib solvent kaise chuna jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Aisa solvent chunte hain jo boiling point par madde ki zyada aur room temperature par kam miqdar hal kare, us se react na kare, impurities ko alag rakhe, thanda hone par achhe crystals de, aur sasta, safe aur aasani se hatne wala ho. Aam misalen: pani, absolute ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride, acetic acid.

blocks.prompt: c) Crystallization ke aham qadam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Saturated garam solution banana; garam filtration (zaroorat ho to hot water funnel); aahista thanda karna; Gooch crucible aur vacuum pump se crystals ko mother liquor se filter karna; hawa, oven ya vacuum desiccator mein sukhana. Rangeen impurities animal charcoal ke saath ubal kar hatai jati hain.

items: Qadam: saturated garam solution; garam filtration; aahista thanda; Gooch crucible mein suction filtration; sukhana (hawa, 100° C oven, ya CaCl₂, silica gel, P₂O₅ wala vacuum desiccator).
Animal charcoal rangeen impurities ko adsorb kar ke hata deta hai.
